title: Design System: AI Infra Bench Studio

display.purpose: Primary A/B metric readouts (peak tok/s and minimum TPOT ms) inside session comparison strips.

headline.purpose: Top-level workspace view headings, slide-over SheetTitle headers, and ConfirmDialog titles.

title.purpose: Flat work-plane headers, telemetry ledger titles, chart headers, and the navigation rail masthead.

body.purpose: Base UI prose, control text, and helper descriptions.

label.purpose: Uppercase data-table column headers and sentence-case form field labels.

mono.purpose: Backend URLs, CLI commands, model/session slugs, live tok/s readouts, and Top-K logprob tables.

shadows.name: overlay-light
shadows.purpose: Light-scheme elevation exclusively for portaled SelectContent menus, Sheet drawers, and ConfirmDialog modals.

shadows.name: overlay-dark
shadows.purpose: Dark-scheme elevation for floating menus, slide-over drawers, and destructive confirmation modals.

shadows.name: sticky-column-divider
shadows.purpose: Leftward 1px structural hairline cast by sticky right-hand table action cells during horizontal scroll.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Primary exponential ease-out for Sheet slide-ins, overlay fades, dialog pop-ins, and SSE live pulse.

motion.name: ease-in-exit
motion.purpose: Snappy exit curve for right-hand Sheet drawer dismissal.

motion.name: duration-control
motion.purpose: Color, border, and thumb-translate transitions on interactive buttons, inputs, selects, and switches.

motion.name: duration-dialog
motion.purpose: Backdrop fade-in and ConfirmDialog pop-in duration.

motion.name: duration-sheet-in
motion.purpose: Slide-over Sheet drawer entrance duration from left or right viewport edge.

motion.name: sse-live-pulse
motion.purpose: Subtle 4px emerald halo pulse indicating active /api/events SSE stream connectivity.

narrative.overview:
AI Infra Bench Studio is an operational metrology and verification workbench built for LLM inference engineers tuning GPU serving backends across air-gapped clusters. Its visual identity trades generic SaaS card grids and decorative chrome for calm, high-density instrumentation: a permanently dark Graphite-Indigo navigation rail (`#111622`) anchors the viewport while the main workspace lays out flat, unnested work planes (`#ffffff` in light mode, `#121826` in dark mode) partitioned by crisp `1px` structural hairlines (`#dce2ec` light, `#212c42` dark). Every font binary, vector icon, and chart primitive ships self-contained inside the single-file offline bundle so corporate SSH-tunneled sessions never degrade without external network access.

Because engineers pivot rapidly between dark terminal windows and bright office monitors, the system pairs dual-scheme `light-dark()` surfaces with high-visibility `#64748b` tactile control boundaries and tabular slashed-zero monospace strictly reserved for endpoints, launch parameters, and live telemetry numbers. Where the initial direction brief proposed `#0284c7` for light-mode accents and `#1f293d` for dark hairlines, the shipped build deepens the light operational accent to `#0369a1` to guarantee ≥4.5:1 white-label contrast on primary actions and calibrates dark structural hairlines to `#212c42` for cleaner plane separation. Nested cards, eyebrow kickers, Unicode glyph substitutes, and modal interruptions for non-destructive inspection are rejected system-wide; deep logs, advanced sweep knobs, and token-level logprob diffs slide out on demand in right-hand drawers.
keyCharacteristics: **Anchored Graphite-Indigo Rail:** A fixed `228px` dark navigation rail (`#111622`) frames live SSE connectivity, workspace counts, and active job progress identically across light and dark themes.

**Flat Hairline-Divided Planes:** Unnested `12px`-radius work planes replace box-inside-box layouts with `1px` structural hairlines (`#dce2ec` / `#212c42`) across forms, multi-column A/B strips, and paired telemetry charts.
**Tactile High-Contrast Controls:** Inputs, selects, switches, and secondary buttons enforce a dedicated `#64748b` stroke (≥3.9:1 boundary contrast) rather than fading into passive divider lines.

**Disciplined Metrology Typography:** Variable geometric UI sans (`Geist Variable`) handles bilingual labels and prose while `Geist Mono Variable` (`tabular-nums slashed-zero`) locks numeric columns, endpoints, and logprob deltas against horizontal jitter.
**Offline-Complete Craft:** Self-hosted variable WOFF2 fonts and uniform `1.75px`-stroke Lucide SVG icons deliver full visual fidelity on air-gapped GPU clusters.

rules.name: The Anchored Rail Rule
rules.body: The left navigation rail remains locked to Graphite-Indigo (`#111622`) with `#232d42` borders and `#38bdf8` active accents in both light and dark modes, preserving a constant instrument-frame anchor while main work planes adapt to ambient lighting.

rules.name: The Tactile Boundary Rule
rules.body: Interactive controls (`Input`, `SelectTrigger`, `Switch`, and secondary `Button`) must use Tactile Control Stroke (`#64748b`) rather than passive structural hairlines (`#dce2ec` or `#212c42`), sharpening to `#334155` (light) or `#94a3b8` (dark) on hover so hit targets remain unmistakable.

rules.name: The Calibrated Signal Rule
rules.body: Emerald, Amber, and Crimson appear strictly to communicate live connection mode, KV-cache saturation (`>68%` Amber, `>85%` Crimson), correctness verdicts, A/B regressions, or destructive actions—never as decorative accents.

rules.name: The Strict Monospace Mandate Rule
rules.body: `Geist Mono Variable` with `tabular-nums slashed-zero` is reserved exclusively for URLs, CLI commands, parameter keys, job/session IDs, and numerical measurements—never applied to prose, headings, or navigation labels as a "technical" costume.

rules.name: The Tabular Ledger Rule
rules.body: Every data table (`tabular-nums`) and numeric readout (`tabular-mono`) locks character advance widths so 1-second SSE telemetry ticks never shift adjacent columns horizontally.

rules.name: The Flat Work Plane Rule
rules.body: Resting work planes, telemetry tables, A/B metric strips, and chart containers carry zero drop shadow (`box-shadow: none`); shadows appear only on portaled overlays (`SelectContent`, `SheetContent`, and `ConfirmDialog`).

rules.name: The Single Elevation Declaration Rule
rules.body: Resting containers declare their boundary once via a `1px` structural hairline (`#dce2ec` / `#212c42`) and surface-to-ground contrast—never pairing a card border with an ambient drop shadow.

dos: Do partition multi-part sections (registration bars, 4-column A/B strips, paired charts, and multi-zone forms) inside a single `12px`-radius `--surface` plane using `1px` `--border` hairlines (`divide-x` / `divide-y`).

Do apply `Geist Mono Variable` (`tabular-nums slashed-zero`) to every URL, CLI flag, model/session slug, concurrency list, throughput figure, and logprob diff so live SSE updates never shift layout width.

Do enforce the `#64748b` tactile border token (`--control-border`) on all text inputs, select triggers, switches, and secondary buttons, paired with a `2px` `--brand` `:focus-visible` outline at `2px` offset.

Do route secondary workflows—live job terminal logs, advanced `aib bench` sweep parameters, CLI onboarding snippets, and per-case reasoning/logits diffs—into right-hand `Sheet` drawers, reserving centered `ConfirmDialog` modals strictly for destructive actions.

Do theme native browser surfaces (`color-scheme`, `accent-color`, `caret-color`, `::selection`, and `scrollbar-color`) from the semantic palette and bundle all fonts and `1.75px` Lucide icons locally for 100% offline operation.
donts: Don't nest bordered or shadowed cards inside another card or work plane; use `1px` structural hairlines or `--surface-subtle` header/footer bands instead.

Don't place uppercase eyebrow or kicker labels above section or panel headings—let the `14px`–`16px` bold heading and `12px` muted description carry hierarchy directly, keeping uppercase `11px` labels strictly inside table `<thead>` columns.
Don't apply drop shadows to resting tables, metric strips, or form containers, and never combine a soft ambient shadow with a card border on resting surfaces.
Don't use Unicode symbols or emoji as icon substitutes, or apply monospace to ordinary prose, button labels, or navigation items.
Don't use pill (`9999px`) corners on buttons, inputs, or cards; keep interactive controls at `7px`–`8px` radius and reserve pills for switches, progress bars, count badges, and status dots.
